query: Based only on these records, would anchoring the new evening medication reminder to an existing daily routine likely work for this user?

relation_specificity.nearby_relation: The user has successfully built habits in the past in general.
relation_specificity.why_it_does_not_license_C: That fact alone does not establish that anchor-chaining specifically is the mechanism that makes habits stick for this user.

coactivation_bridge: ev_A shows the stretch habit became automatic by anchoring to teeth-brushing; ev_B shows the blood-pressure-log habit became automatic anchoring to that same stretch. Together they support C: Anchoring the new evening medication reminder to an existing daily routine would likely work for this user, because both the stretch-after-teeth-brushing habit and the blood-pressure-log-after-stretch habit show the same habit-stacking pattern succeeding reliably.
